title: line-height - Typography - Tailwind CSS
content_text:
TYPOGRAPHY line-height Utilities for controlling the leading, or line height, of an element. Removing the leading Use the leading-none utility to set the line height of an element equal to its font size: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

For CSS variables, you can also use the leading-() syntax:

This is just a shorthand for leading-[var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Responsive design Prefix a line-height utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above:

Learn more about using variants in the variants documentation. Customizing your theme The leading- utilities are driven by the --spacing theme variable, which can be customized in your own theme: @theme { --spacing: 1px; } Learn more about customizing the spacing scale in the theme variable documentation. line-clamp list-style-image
